# Perfuncted v1.3.0

- Improved Wayland desktop detection and authorized input handling, including clearer permission errors.
- More reliable accessibility actions, input targeting, and recovery from interrupted operations.
- Improved screenshot behavior and desktop capability reporting.
- One self-contained Flatpak bundle, using standard Flatpak sandbox permissions.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nskaggs/perfuncted/compare/v1.2.3...v1.3.0
